risks.risk: Whether it actually sews correctly (timing/feed/needle alignment) vs only running.

risks.risk: Motor/drive smoothness under load (belt/pulley/bearings) rather than brief testing.
risks.proof: Video of the motor running and sewing at speed for 1–2 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven smooth (worst case: may need motor/drive service).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cord, tools) and whether manual is included.
risks.proof: Photo inventory laid out clearly: needles, bobbins, presser feet, power cable, any tools, and manual cover/pages.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete (worst case: accessories/manual not included).

risks.risk: Exact brand/model unknown, affecting parts availability and value.

risks.proof: Close-up photos of needle plate/bed, feed dogs, and underside/presser foot area.

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the brand/model plate + serial number.
Send a short video of the machine sewing on fabric (show stitch quality and feed).
Send a video of the motor running while sewing (1–2 minutes).
Lay out and photograph all accessories and the manual (readable).
